newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan says to re-tender for wheat, barley.
newsitem.headline: Japan says to re-tender for wheat, barley.

text.p: The Food Agency of Japan said on Thursday it would re-tender for 20,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat and 20,000 of Canadian barley on March 6.
The agency, the sole importer of wheat, barley and rice in Japan, bought 180,000 tonnes of wheat and 60,000 of barley at a late-afternoon tender on Thursday.
But it failed to purchase 20,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat and 20,000 of Canadian barley due to a price gap with local trade houses, an agency official said.
"There was a wide gap between the two sides, and we decided to hold a tender for them again on March 6," the official said.
